title: Neon Phasefall
summary: A neon phase experiment where shifting lanes, tiles, and phases must sync to survive.
instructions: Use left/right arrows to swap lanes and stay in the active phase while the pulse windows shift.

overlay.startCopy: Enter the neon phase experiment, read the active phase, and slip between the safe lanes as the drop accelerates.

help.title: How To Start
steps: Press Start Drop in the center overlay.
Use Left and Right to switch lanes.
Match the active phase before the block reaches you.
Keep your lane aligned with the phase window.
tips: The safest lane can change as the phase shifts.
Watch the HUD phase label before each move.

onboarding.title: Phase Setup
startSteps: Open Help to see the phase timing rule.
Press Start Drop to begin the lane run.
Move into the active phase before the block hits.
onboarding.firstGoal: Survive the first phase cycle and learn the swap rhythm.
